+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import collections.abc as cabc
+import typing as t
+

+def file_edit_result(
+    text: bytes | bytearray,
+    editor: str | None = None,

+) -> bytes | None: ...

+def file_edit_result(
+    text: str,
+    editor: str | None = None,
+    env: cabc.Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
+    require_save: bool = True,
+    extension: str = ".txt",
+) -> str | None: ...
+
+
+@t.overload
+def file_edit_result(
+    text: None = None,
+    editor: str | None = None,
+    env: cabc.Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
+    require_save: bool = True,
+    extension: str = ".txt",
+    filename: str | cabc.Iterable[str] | None = None,
+) -> bool | None: ...
+
+
+def file_edit_result(
+    text: str | bytes | bytearray | None = None,
+    editor: str | None = None,
+    env: cabc.Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
+    require_save: bool = True,
+    extension: str = ".txt",
+    filename: str | cabc.Iterable[str] | None = None,
+) -> str | bytes | bytearray | bool | None:
+    """Works exactly like :func:`click.edit`, except that when
+    ``filename`` is given, ``True`` is returned after the editor has been
+    invoked on the file(s) instead of ``None``. This lets a caller tell
+    that the editor was launched.
+
+    If the editor cannot be opened a :exc:`UsageError` is raised.
+
+    See :func:`click.edit` for a description of the parameters.
+    """
+    from ._termui_impl import Editor
+
+    ed = Editor(editor=editor, env=env, require_save=require_save, extension=extension)
+
+    if filename is None:
+        return ed.edit(text)
+
+    if isinstance(filename, str):
+        filename = (filename,)
+
+    ed.edit_files(filenames=filename)
+    return True

@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
+import platform
+import tempfile
+
+import pytest
+
+import click
+from click.file_edit_result import file_edit_result
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    platform.system() == "Windows", reason="No sed on Windows."
+)
+
+
+def test_text_returns_edited_text():
+    result = file_edit_result("a\nb", editor="sed -i~ 's/$/Test/'")
+    assert result == "aTest\nbTest\n"
+
+
+def test_filename_returns_true():
+    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode="w") as named_tempfile:
+        named_tempfile.write("a\nb")
+        named_tempfile.flush()
+
+        result = file_edit_result(
+            filename=named_tempfile.name, editor="sed -i~ 's/$/Test/'"
+        )
+        assert result is True
+
+        with open(named_tempfile.name) as reopened_file:
+            assert reopened_file.read() == "aTest\nbTest"
+
+
+def test_editor_failure_raises():
+    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode="w") as named_tempfile:
+        with pytest.raises(click.ClickException):
+            file_edit_result(filename=named_tempfile.name, editor="false")
